arc_scot_fiddler.text: A Strathspey is a Highland dance tune with a snap in the rhythm, like a bagpiper falling down a short stair. Join in at the chorus. Nobody will check the words.
Ceilidh simply means a visit, a gathering, an evening with songs and stories. This one has been waiting a long time.

arc_scot_treasurer.text: The Trust is registered, the accounts are in the biscuit tin and the biscuits are in a different biscuit tin. We own the hall, the grazing and the old rent book.
If anybody asks, a community buyout is just a village doing its own shopping, only with more paperwork and a better view.
